title: OntoFuel NVL data contract (stub — NFM-228 Task 2 / H1a)
description: Minimal contract spec capturing what the runtime validator (src/utils/contractValidation.ts, validateNvlContract) enforces for a VERSIONED contract (schema_version present). This is a documentation/swap stub: NFM-227 will replace it in place with the full Draft 2020-12 conformance schema consumed by the Python-side gate (tests/test_nvl_contract.py). The committed E2E fixture (e2e/fixtures/nvl_ontology_data.json, schema_version 1.0) MUST conform to this. NOTE: the JS runtime deliberately does NOT use ajv (bundle budget) — validateNvlContract is the programmatic source of truth; this schema documents the same contract for cross-language conformance.

schema_version.description: Contract version, e.g. '1.0'. Absent => versionless/backward-compatible (validateNvlContract only requires nodes[] then).

from.description: MUST reference an existing node id
